## Goal
Owners hear about bookings, messages and handoffs where they are, written like a person.

## Owns
- `services/notifications/**`
- `infra/cdk/lib/notifications-stack.ts`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Preference routing per event type; quiet hours; dedupe per event id.
- Resend email and VAPID push adapters with retries; Telnyx outbound call only for urgent handoff.
- Every template passes conversation-style (chat).

## Steps
- Notification copy examples: "New booking: Tunde, haircut, tomorrow at 3." not "A booking has been created."

## Acceptance
- In dev, a test booking reaches Telegram and email within 10 s.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run services/notifications` and `make test` before opening the PR.
